visual_rule: Every voiced beat owns one unique full-screen composition in which Niko and the team visibly perform the narrated soccer action; no story artwork is reused.
text_panel_policy: No instructional cards during the story; only a short opening title and final end card are allowed.

character_continuity.niko: A cheerful seven-year-old Japanese-Australian boy with warm tan skin, short tousled black hair, a teal headband, teal-and-navy soccer kit, orange shin guards, and white trainers; sporty ninja inspiration only, with no mask or weapons.
character_continuity.lila: A shy seven-year-old girl with deep brown skin, two puff ponytails with yellow ties, a sunny yellow-and-purple soccer kit, purple socks, and white trainers.
character_continuity.team: Four diverse children in coral, blue, green, and purple community soccer kits, all friendly and age appropriate.

shots.narrator_line: At the rainbow community pitch, Niko spotted a new player named Lila waiting by the gate. He rolled the ball close and offered a friendly wave.
shots.visual: Niko gently rolls the ball toward nervous Lila and waves while the welcoming team waits farther inside the colourful pitch.
shots.motion: Low ball-level push-in, rolling-ball trail, fluttering pennants, and Niko's clear welcome wave.

shots.narrator_line: Niko showed his quiet-focus move: one slow breath, arms wide, foot softly on the ball. Can you balance too?
shots.visual: Niko demonstrates a calm one-foot-on-ball balance pose while Lila copies him and begins to smile.
shots.motion: Gentle camera orbit, breathing glow rings, swaying grass, and a three-count balance sparkle.

shots.narrator_line: Next came tiny ninja touches: tap right, tap left, stop. Niko zigzagged between bright cones without racing away from his friend.
shots.visual: Niko actively dribbles right-left-stop through three bright cones while Lila follows the footwork path beside him.
shots.motion: Ground-level side tracking, curved footwork trails, cone pulses, and a clean stop-freeze.

shots.narrator_line: Then Niko turned his toes, looked at Lila, and sent a slow, gentle pass straight across the grass.
shots.character_line: Your turn, Lila. I am right here!
shots.visual: Niko makes eye contact and passes gently to Lila; the ball is visibly travelling between them along a bright curved arc.
shots.motion: Ball-follow tracking shot, glowing pass arc, turning-foot cue, and Lila preparing her first touch.

shots.narrator_line: Lila cushioned the ball with one careful foot. It wobbled, but she kept it close. Niko clapped, and the whole team cheered.
shots.visual: Lila visibly traps the wobbling ball under control while Niko claps and every teammate celebrates her effort.
shots.motion: Small ball wobble, celebratory camera lift, clapping sparkles, and bouncing team pennants.

shots.narrator_line: Now the players made a passing triangle. Niko to Lila, Lila to Sam, and Sam back to Niko. Three kind passes kept everyone included.
shots.visual: Niko, Lila, and Sam form a clear triangle and each actively passes in sequence, with the other teammates moving into helpful space.
shots.motion: Overhead-to-low camera sweep, three sequential ball arcs, moving paper-cut field arrows, and quick encouraging waves.

shots.narrator_line: Lila tried a shot and missed the goal. Nobody groaned. Niko returned the ball, and the team made a new plan together.
shots.character_line: A miss is just another chance to help!
shots.visual: The ball sits safely beside the goal after Lila's miss; Niko returns it while teammates gather supportively and point out a new passing route.
shots.motion: Soft ball-return roll, route arrows appearing one by one, reassuring nods, and a warm colour lift.

shots.narrator_line: Pass, move, share! The new plan worked. Lila tapped in the final goal, then every player joined the biggest kindness-team cheer.
shots.visual: Lila taps the ball into the net after a visible team passing move; Niko and all players jump, wave, and cheer together around her.
shots.motion: Fast ball-to-net track, net ripple, colourful confetti ribbons, camera arc, ensemble jump, and final team pose.
